bpInfo.title: ABOUT BP BERNECK®
bpInfo.paragraph1: are coated with decorative melaminic laminate - on one or two sides - with a great decorative effect and excellent surface resistance to scratching and abrasion. The colors and textures were developed in tune with global design trends, which provide endless combination possibilities.
bpInfo.paragraph2: The panels have a closed surface that reduces the proliferation of microorganisms, ideal for environments that require easy cleaning. The standardized dimensions, allied to the practicality of a finished panel, allow the simplification of the furniture production process.
bpInfo.paragraph3: All patterns have edge ribbons developed in partnership with the best suppliers in the market. It is important that all panel edges are sealed, to ensure superior quality and durability.
